title: CJ: named fail-closed N1 N5 N6 browser acceptance specs
public_pr_body:
CJ supplies the three named browser specs for N1 paid/unpaid breaks, N5 blank-company setup and N6 both email editors. Builder 3 continued the existing draft and committed tests/CJ-BUILDER-3-RESULTS.md.

Exact head: ff29ca191879ec954e305ec0eb200501789a5bcf. Collection command: `REVIEWER_REQUIRE_DATABASE=1 npx playwright test tests/e2e/acceptance --list` — PASS, 3 tests in 3 files. Runtime command: `REVIEWER_REQUIRE_DATABASE=1 npx playwright test tests/e2e/acceptance` — FAIL in global setup, TEST_SUPABASE_URL unset; browser assertions NOT TESTED. Current local Docker socket access is denied, distinct from the historical ENOSPC.

CI run 41825174221: failure (web success, integration skipped, ci-gate failed). No Ready workaround or production SQL. Claude Code must run against the independently verified fake backend with reviewed releases. Exact environment/limits and remaining manual coverage are in the results file; final handover on coordination #271.

- [x] Three specs and exact-command execution evidence
